licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics, slurs and other marks, then checked bar by bar by fresh checkers (the 64th-note runs of bars 11 and 62–64 corrected, then clean). The German singing translation is left out. Grace notes are written without a slash, as printed; the small notes of bar 86 are written as a grace-note turn. Playback tempos: Andante ♪ = 70 (♩ = 35), Allegro ♩ = 93, Adagio ♩ = 40, from the lengths of four recordings (Böhm, Jacobs, Muti, Cantelli; median about 4:58). The recordings do not split the sections, so the balance between them is an estimate; Mozart gives the words only.
